premises.name: QFORM ridge spectral-window density theorem
premises.scope: s_3(A)>=1 and spectral projection onto |lambda|>=1/64 with max physical leverage <=1/32 implies continuous density <64; arbitrary small nonseparable tails allowed

premises.name: account03/B18 QFORM-RIDGE-HALF-RIESZ-TWOEIG-v1
premises.scope: s_2(S)>=s and diffuse |lambda|>=s/64 window imply half-Riesz bound C_H s^-1/2; after a nonzero physical pivot gives density C_H/sqrt(|a|s)

premises.name: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov marginal-density theorem
premises.scope: cap-one product density; every k-dimensional orthogonal marginal density <=2^(k/2), hence every unit linear bank <=sqrt(2)

partner_result_applied.application: Alternative 3 of QFORM-TWO-STAGE-WINDOW-STARPAIR-v1: a physical pivot |a|>=1/512 with diffuse two-eigenvalue Schur window has ||p_Q||_infinity<576.

new_results.name: QFORM-TWO-STAGE-WINDOW-STARPAIR-v1
new_results.statement: Every target A either lies in the solved overall diffuse branch (<64), lies in the solved nonzero-pivot/diffuse-Schur branch (<576), or has an original near-zero heavy star, a physical 2x2 principal determinant >=2^-18, or a heavy star in a physical Schur residual.

new_results.name: QFORM-HEAVY-STAR-PRODUCT-PROVENANCE-v1
new_results.statement: For the outer heavy-star branch Q=aX_i^2+2 beta X_iY+R(X_rest) with |a|<1/512 and beta>1/512, Y is a unit original-coordinate linear bank with ||p_Y||_infinity<=sqrt(2), and X_i is independent of the entire source generating (Y,R); no independence between Y and R is claimed.
